title: A Full Lantern Festival
synopsis: Learn about the history and customs behind the Lantern Festival, a traditional Chinese holiday at the end of the Spring Festival.

fullText.simplified:
圆圆的元宵节

    说起中国的传统节日，大家都很熟悉春节和中秋节，也有不少人尝过饺子和月饼。事实上，元宵节也是一个很重要的中国传统节日。它是一个圆圆的、亮亮的可爱节日。
    元宵节的日期是农历一月十五号，一般被认为是春节的最后一天。农历一月也叫“元月”，夜晚叫“宵”，所以“元宵”的汉语本意是“第一个月圆的夜晚”。元宵节是新的一年里第一个月圆之夜，是个同样重要的节日。
    在这一天，人们会吃圆形的元宵。元宵是用一种特别的面做的，软软的，里面是甜甜的糖。元宵看起来像满月，圆圆的；吃起来甜甜的。这正像是人们对新一年生活的希望——圆圆的，甜甜的。
    同时，元宵节这一天，人们会做各种各样的花灯，挂在家门口和街道上。元宵节的晚上，人们会走出家门去街上游玩和赏灯。各种大小、各种形状的花灯把街道装扮得十分漂亮。有些灯上还写着谜语，大家可以猜灯谜。很多商场和电视台也会举办活动，邀请人们看花灯、猜灯谜。一时间，天上的月亮和地上的花灯，分不清楚哪一个更亮。
    美中不足的是元宵节不是法定假日，春节的法定假日只有七天，很多人不得不在元宵节前结束假期，不能过一个完整的传统春节。但人们仍然会坚持吃元宵、看花灯，元宵节的夜晚同样甜蜜明亮。
    如果你想感受春节，可以在元宵节来中国。这时候，各行各业的工作人员已经可以提供服务了，但节日的感觉却还在。
fullText.traditional:
圓圓的元宵節

    說起中國的傳統節日，大家都很熟悉春節和中秋節，也有不少人嘗過餃子和月餅。事實上，元宵節也是一個很重要的中國傳統節日。它是一個圓圓的、亮亮的可愛節日。
    元宵節的日期是農曆一月十五號，一般被認為是春節的最後一天。農曆一月也叫“元月”，夜晚叫“宵”，所以“元宵”的漢語本意是“第一個月圓的夜晚”。元宵節是新的一年裡第一個月圓之夜，是個同樣重要的節日。
    在這一天，人們會吃圓形的元宵。元宵是用一種特別的麵做的，軟軟的，裡面是甜甜的糖。元宵看起來像滿月，圓圓的；吃起來甜甜的。這正像是人們對新一年生活的希望——圓圓的，甜甜的。
    同時，元宵節這一天，人們會做各種各樣的花燈，掛在家門口和街道上。元宵節的晚上，人們會走出家門去街上遊玩和賞燈。各種大小、各種形狀的花燈把街道裝扮得十分漂亮。有些燈上還寫著謎語，大家可以猜燈謎。很多商場和電視臺也會舉辦活動，邀請人們看花燈、猜燈謎。一時間，天上的月亮和地上的花燈，分不清楚哪一個更亮。
    美中不足的是元宵節不是法定假日，春節的法定假日只有七天，很多人不得不在元宵節前結束假期，不能過一個完整的傳統春節。但人們仍然會堅持吃元宵、看花燈，元宵節的夜晚同樣甜蜜明亮。
    如果你想感受春節，可以在元宵節來中國。這時候，各行各業的工作人員已經可以提供服務了，但節日的感覺卻還在。

sentences.english: A Full Lantern Festival

sentences.simplified: 说起中国的传统节日，大家都很熟悉春节和中秋节，
sentences.traditional: 說起中國的傳統節日，大家都很熟悉春節和中秋節，
sentences.pinyin: shuō qǐ zhōng guó de chuán tǒng jié rì dà jiā dōu hěn shú xī chūn jié hé zhōng qiū jié

sentences.simplified: 也有不少人尝过饺子和月饼。
sentences.traditional: 也有不少人嘗過餃子和月餅。
sentences.pinyin: yě yǒu bù shǎo rén cháng guò jiǎo zi hé yuè bǐng
sentences.english: When it comes to Chinese traditional holidays, everyone is very familiar with the Spring Festival and the Mid-Autumn Festival.

sentences.simplified: 事实上，元宵节也是一个很重要的中国传统节日。
sentences.traditional: 事實上，元宵節也是一個很重要的中國傳統節日。
sentences.pinyin: shì shí shang yuán xiāo jié yě shì yí ge hěn zhòng yào de zhōng guó chuán tǒng jié rì
sentences.english: Many people have also tried dumplings and mooncakes before.

sentences.simplified: 它是一个圆圆的、亮亮的可爱节日。
sentences.traditional: 它是一個圓圓的、亮亮的可愛節日。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì yí ge yuán yuán de liàng liàng de kě ài jié rì
sentences.english: In fact, the Lantern Festival is also a very important Chinese traditional holiday.
It is a full, bright, and lovely holiday.

sentences.simplified: 元宵节的日期是农历一月十五号，
sentences.traditional: 元宵節的日期是農曆一月十五號，
sentences.pinyin: yuán xiāo jié de rì qī shì nóng lì yī yuè shí wǔ hào

sentences.simplified: 一般被认为是春节的最后一天。
sentences.traditional: 一般被認為是春節的最後一天。
sentences.pinyin: yì bān bèi rèn wéi shì chūn jié de zuì hòu yì tiān
sentences.english: The Lantern Festival occurs on the 15th day of the first month of the lunar calendar.

sentences.simplified: 农历一月也叫“元月”，夜晚叫“宵”，
sentences.traditional: 農曆一月也叫“元月”，夜晚叫“宵”，
sentences.pinyin: nóng lì yī yuè yě jiào yuán yuè yè wǎn jiào xiāo
sentences.english: It is generally considered to be the last day of the Spring Festival.

sentences.simplified: 所以“元宵”的汉语本意是“第一个月圆的夜晚”。
sentences.traditional: 所以“元宵”的漢語本意是“第一個月圓的夜晚”。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ yuán xiāo de hàn yǔ běn yì shì dì yī ge yuè yuán de yè wǎn
sentences.english: The first month of the lunar calendar is also called the “yuan month”, and the night is called “xiao”.

sentences.simplified: 元宵节是新的一年里第一个月圆之夜，是个同样重要的节日。
sentences.traditional: 元宵節是新的一年裡第一個月圓之夜，是個同樣重要的節日。
sentences.pinyin: yuán xiāo jié shì xīn de yì nián lǐ dì yī ge yuè yuán zhī yè shì ge tóng yàng zhòng yào de jié rì
sentences.english: So, the original meaning of “yuanxiao” [the Lantern Festival] is “the first night of the full moon”.
The Lantern Festival is the night of the first full moon of the new year and is an equally important festival.

sentences.simplified: 在这一天，人们会吃圆形的元宵。
sentences.traditional: 在這一天，人們會吃圓形的元宵。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè yì tiān rén men huì chī yuán xíng de yuán xiāo

sentences.simplified: 元宵是用一种特别的面做的，软软的，里面是甜甜的糖。
sentences.traditional: 元宵是用一種特別的麵做的，軟軟的，裡面是甜甜的糖。
sentences.pinyin: yuán xiāo shì yòng yì zhǒng tè bié de miàn zuò de ruǎn ruǎn de lǐ miàn shì tián tián de táng
sentences.english: On this day, people will eat round sticky rice dumplings.

sentences.simplified: 元宵看起来像满月，圆圆的；吃起来甜甜的。
sentences.traditional: 元宵看起來像滿月，圓圓的；吃起來甜甜的。
sentences.pinyin: yuán xiāo kàn qǐ lái xiàng mǎn yuè yuán yuán de chī qǐ lái tián tián de
sentences.english: Sticky rice dumplings are made of a special type of flour. They are soft and filled with sweet sugar.

sentences.simplified: 这正像是人们对新一年生活的希望——圆圆的，甜甜的。
sentences.traditional: 這正像是人們對新一年生活的希望——圓圓的，甜甜的。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhèng xiàng shì rén men duì xīn yì nián shēng huó de xī wàng yuán yuán de tián tián de
sentences.english: Sticky rice dumplings are round like the full moon, and they taste sweet.
This is precisely what people are hoping the new year of life will be like—full and sweet.

sentences.simplified: 同时，元宵节这一天，
sentences.traditional: 同時，元宵節這一天，
sentences.pinyin: tóng shí yuán xiāo jié zhè yì tiān

sentences.simplified: 人们会做各种各样的花灯，挂在家门口和街道上。
sentences.traditional: 人們會做各種各樣的花燈，掛在家門口和街道上。
sentences.pinyin: rén men huì zuò gè zhǒng gè yàng de huā dēng guà zài jiā mén kǒu hé jiē dào shang
sentences.english: At the same time, on the day of the Lantern Festival, ..

sentences.simplified: 元宵节的晚上，人们会走出家门去街上游玩和赏灯。
sentences.traditional: 元宵節的晚上，人們會走出家門去街上遊玩和賞燈。
sentences.pinyin: yuán xiāo jié de wǎn shang rén men huì zǒu chū jiā mén qù jiē shang yóu wán hé shǎng dēng
sentences.english: .. people will make various kinds of lanterns to hang in front of homes and on the street.

sentences.simplified: 各种大小、各种形状的花灯把街道装扮得十分漂亮。
sentences.traditional: 各種大小、各種形狀的花燈把街道裝扮得十分漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: gè zhǒng dà xiǎo gè zhǒng xíng zhuàng de huā dēng bǎ jiē dào zhuāng bàn de shí fēn piào liang
sentences.english: On the night of the Lantern Festival, people will come out of their homes and onto the street to have fun and enjoy the lanterns.

sentences.simplified: 有些灯上还写着谜语，大家可以猜灯谜。
sentences.traditional: 有些燈上還寫著謎語，大家可以猜燈謎。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu xiē dēng shang hái xiě zhe mí yǔ dà jiā kě yǐ cāi dēng mí
sentences.english: Lanterns of all sizes and shapes decorate the streets beautifully.

sentences.simplified: 很多商场和电视台也会举办活动，邀请人们看花灯、猜灯谜。
sentences.traditional: 很多商場和電視臺也會舉辦活動，邀請人們看花燈、猜燈謎。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō shāng chǎng hé diàn shì tái yě huì jǔ bàn huó dòng yāo qǐng rén men kàn huā dēng cāi dēng mí
sentences.english: Some lanterns also have riddles on them, and people can try to solve the riddles.

sentences.simplified: 一时间，天上的月亮和地上的花灯，分不清楚哪一个更亮。
sentences.traditional: 一時間，天上的月亮和地上的花燈，分不清楚哪一個更亮。
sentences.pinyin: yì shí jiān tiān shàng de yuè liang hé dì shang de huā dēng fēn bù qīng chu nǎ yí ge gèng liàng
sentences.english: Many shopping malls and TV stations will also organize events where people are invited to enjoy lanterns and solve lantern riddles.
Suddenly, it’s hard to tell which is brighter, the moon in the sky or the lanterns on the ground.

sentences.simplified: 美中不足的是元宵节不是法定假日，
sentences.traditional: 美中不足的是元宵節不是法定假日，
sentences.pinyin: měi zhōng bù zú de shì yuán xiāo jié bú shì fǎ dìng jià rì

sentences.simplified: 春节的法定假日只有七天，
sentences.traditional: 春節的法定假日只有七天，
sentences.pinyin: chūn jié de fǎ dìng jià rì zhǐ yǒu qī tiān
sentences.english: The only imperfection is that the Lantern Festival is not a public holiday.

sentences.simplified: 很多人不得不在元宵节前结束假期，不能过一个完整的传统春节。
sentences.traditional: 很多人不得不在元宵節前結束假期，不能過一個完整的傳統春節。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō rén bù dé bù zài yuán xiāo jié qián jié shù jià qī bù néng guò yí ge wán zhěng de chuán tǒng chūn jié
sentences.english: The Spring Festival public holiday is only seven days.

sentences.simplified: 但人们仍然会坚持吃元宵、看花灯，
sentences.traditional: 但人們仍然會堅持吃元宵、看花燈，
sentences.pinyin: dàn rén men réng rán huì jiān chí chī yuán xiāo kàn huā dēng
sentences.english: Many people must end their holidays before the Lantern Festival and cannot experience a full traditional Spring Festival.

sentences.simplified: 元宵节的夜晚同样甜蜜明亮。
sentences.traditional: 元宵節的夜晚同樣甜蜜明亮。
sentences.pinyin: yuán xiāo jié de yè wǎn tóng yàng tián mì míng liàng
sentences.english: However, people will nonetheless eat glutinous rice balls and enjoy the lanterns.
The night of the Lantern Festival is equally sweet and bright.

sentences.simplified: 如果你想感受春节，可以在元宵节来中国。
sentences.traditional: 如果你想感受春節，可以在元宵節來中國。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng gǎn shòu chūn jié kě yǐ zài yuán xiāo jié lái zhōng guó

sentences.simplified: 这时候，各行各业的工作人员已经可以提供服务了，但节日的感觉却还在。
sentences.traditional: 這時候，各行各業的工作人員已經可以提供服務了，但節日的感覺卻還在。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou gè háng gè yè de gōng zuò rén yuán yǐ jīng kě yǐ tí gōng fú wù le dàn jié rì de gǎn jué què hái zài
sentences.english: If you want to experience the Spring Festival, you can come to China during the Lantern Festival.

sentence_translations: A Full Lantern Festival
When it comes to Chinese traditional holidays, everyone is very familiar with the Spring Festival and the Mid-Autumn Festival.
Many people have also tried dumplings and mooncakes before.
In fact, the Lantern Festival is also a very important Chinese traditional holiday.
It is a full, bright, and lovely holiday.
The Lantern Festival occurs on the 15th day of the first month of the lunar calendar.
It is generally considered to be the last day of the Spring Festival.
The first month of the lunar calendar is also called the “yuan month”, and the night is called “xiao”.
So, the original meaning of “yuanxiao” [the Lantern Festival] is “the first night of the full moon”.
The Lantern Festival is the night of the first full moon of the new year and is an equally important festival.
On this day, people will eat round sticky rice dumplings.
Sticky rice dumplings are made of a special type of flour. They are soft and filled with sweet sugar.
Sticky rice dumplings are round like the full moon, and they taste sweet.
This is precisely what people are hoping the new year of life will be like—full and sweet.
At the same time, on the day of the Lantern Festival, ..
.. people will make various kinds of lanterns to hang in front of homes and on the street.
On the night of the Lantern Festival, people will come out of their homes and onto the street to have fun and enjoy the lanterns.
Lanterns of all sizes and shapes decorate the streets beautifully.
Some lanterns also have riddles on them, and people can try to solve the riddles.
Many shopping malls and TV stations will also organize events where people are invited to enjoy lanterns and solve lantern riddles.
Suddenly, it’s hard to tell which is brighter, the moon in the sky or the lanterns on the ground.
The only imperfection is that the Lantern Festival is not a public holiday.
The Spring Festival public holiday is only seven days.
Many people must end their holidays before the Lantern Festival and cannot experience a full traditional Spring Festival.
However, people will nonetheless eat glutinous rice balls and enjoy the lanterns.
The night of the Lantern Festival is equally sweet and bright.
If you want to experience the Spring Festival, you can come to China during the Lantern Festival.
By this time, workers in different occupations will be able to provide services, but the holiday atmosphere will still be present.
